US Sanctions Indian Firms and Individuals Over Iran Oil Trade

The United States has imposed sanctions on two Mumbai-based companies, SSPL Solutions Private Limited and Samudra Marine Services Private Limited, and five Indian nationals associated with them. These actions are part of a broader US crackdown against Iran's oil trade, referred to as Operation Economic Outcast. The sanctions target alleged involvement in oil trade with Iran.
